svg.title: Shadow Weaver — Threads of Night. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Shadow classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 9 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Loom of Dusk forks into Barbed Thread then Night Unraveled, or Frayed Resolve then Strings Cut Short. Cloak of Woven Night forks into Tightened Weave then Seamless Shroud, or Umbral Whetstone. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Shadow jutsu.

lean (+4% together)","rationale":"Shadow Weaver is a rank-A Bukijutsu Sustained DPS kit: four 40 EP Shadow attacks (Domain, Severance, Step, Dance; 60 AP, cooldown 7) and three 35% self Increase Damage Given buffs (Domain, Step, Shell) that compound when their windows overlap. The old +5 Damage route lifted all four attacks 40 \u2192 45, a full tier each; Burst now sets up the buffs on the Hidden Art and pays off with +2 Damage (40 \u2192 42) on the capstone. Because the three buffs compound, no legal allocation passes +5% Increase Damage Given, the level the roster holds for three compounding rows; the Burst route is where it peaks. Loom of Dusk answers \"How do I win the exchange: strike harder or blunt their strikes?\" (Burst or Suppression on Severance); Cloak of Woven Night answers \"How do I fight from inside my own weave: thicken it or sharpen it?\" (Fortress on Shell or the Umbral Whetstone buff lean). No Afterburn, Lifesteal, Reflect, Heal or Increase Damage Taken row exists, so none is invented. DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":100.0,"gain":0,"final":100.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Seamless Shroud"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Nine nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, as before the batch. The kit has four supported tags on nine rows (Damage x4, Increase Damage Given x3, Decrease Damage Given x1, Decrease Damage Taken x1). Burst takes Damage with Increase Damage Given as its setup, Suppression takes Decrease Damage Given and Fortress takes Decrease Damage Taken. A fourth capstone could only be a second Increase Damage Given route: it would read as Burst without the Damage, and on three compounding self buffs it could not exceed Burst's +5% without becoming the tree's strongest offensive stack. Umbral Whetstone is a Hidden-Art leaf so that the defensive root completes a full build (06, 07, 08, 09) without Loom of Dusk; it shares Barbed Thread's tag and rows (see design_review.concerns).","design_notes":["2026-10-04 rebalance (BALANCE_REVIEW_METHOD.md). Kept: graph, names, both Foundations, Frayed Resolve, Strings Cut Short, the Fortress line and Umbral Whetstone's leaf role. First pass: Barbed Thread +2 Damage \u2192 Increase Damage Given; Night Unraveled +3 Damage \u2192 +2 Damage, +2% Increase Damage Given; Strings Cut Short's +3% Increase Damage Given rider \u2192 +2% Decrease Damage Taken. The old +5 Damage route lifted Domain, Severance, Step and Dance 40 \u2192 45 (four Normal \u2192 High tier jumps), and Damage on the Hidden Art made +2 Damage the obvious fourth purchase for Suppression. Roster pass: Loom of Dusk drops its +2% Increase Damage Given (now +2% Decrease Damage Given only, the Falling Ember Petals pattern), Barbed Thread +2 \u2192 +3% and Umbral Whetstone +3 \u2192 +2%, so the three compounding buffs peak at +5% on the Burst route (first pass: +6% on Burst, +7% with no capstone).","Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2 (40 \u2192 42, no tier change), Increase Damage Given +5% (the Burst route; the no-capstone 01, 02, 06, 09 also reaches it but is dominated by Burst), Decrease Damage Given +10%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%.","Impact: the three self buffs are jutsu-sourced and multiply in sequence (\u00a73b): \u00d71.35\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.46 unenhanced, \u00d71.40\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.74 on the Burst route (+11.5%); a single window gains about +4%. Burst's +2 Damage multiplies under the same windows, about \u00d71.17 with all three live. Fortress cuts hits in Shell's window from \u00d70.65 to \u00d70.55 (\u221215%); Suppression cuts the Severed target's hits from \u00d70.70 to \u00d70.60 (\u221214%). The bloodline passive (Increase Damage Given on Fire, Lightning, Shadow and element-less hits) multiplies last.","Reach: Domain's and Step's buff rows list Fire, Lightning, Shadow and None, so they also raise Fire and Lightning jutsu, basic attacks and other element-less hits; Shell's buff is element-less (its Bukijutsu filter is not binding). Severance's Decrease Damage Given and Shell's Decrease Damage Taken list all four stat types and no element, so each covers every non-pierce hit the target deals or the caster takes in its window.","Delivery: all five jutsu are cooldown 7; buffs and debuffs are live the two rounds after the cast and never in the cast round (\u00a73b), so Domain's and Step's buffs never raise their own hit. Domain (GROUND spiral) and Step (EMPTY_GROUND circle) carry SELF buff rows realized on the caster at cast; their damage rows are friendly fire ENEMIES, so no supported row is an ally hazard.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Cloak of Woven Night (Shell 38%) or Frayed Resolve (Severance 35%), both defensive; Suppression takes Barbed Thread (buffs 38%) or Cloak of Woven Night (Shell 40%); Fortress takes Umbral Whetstone (buffs 39%) or Loom of Dusk (Severance 32%, buffs 37%). Fortress's Loom-free fourth stacks the capstone's +2% rider with its sibling Hidden Art to +4% Increase Damage Given (\u00d71.39\u00b3 against \u00d71.35\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d71.09 with all three windows); that stays below Burst's +5% and adds no Damage, so it is Fortress's offensive lean, not a dominant stack. No fourth adds Damage. Three full allocations are dominated, each with Umbral Whetstone outside the Fortress: 01, 04, 06, 09 and 01, 06, 07, 09 lose to Barbed Thread in the same slot, and 01, 02, 06, 09 loses to Night Unraveled."],"risks":["Classification: Shadow is the single qualifying element; sharing it with other bloodlines is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). 6 of 9 kit rows carry Shadow; Severance's Decrease Damage Given and both Shell rows carry no element, so Suppression and Fortress depend wholly on the proposed jutsu-classification resolver (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Shell's Increase Damage Given row is one of Burst's three compounding windows and is reached only through G1 plus Shell's authored classification, so the quoted \u00d71.40\u00b3 figures assume it: under today's resolver Burst's peak is \u00d71.40\u00b2 \u00d7 1.35 (\u2248 \u00d71.13 rather than \u2248 \u00d71.17). Off-kit Shadow coverage (NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN) is unverified.","Off-kit Damage: +2 Damage reaches every Shadow Damage row the caster can use; an off-kit Shadow jutsu at 50 would become 52. No off-kit catalog exists to check.","Increase Damage Given is the high-leverage tag: one +1% lifts three compounding windows, and Domain's and Step's rows also raise Fire, Lightning and element-less hits. Its +5% maximum sits on the Burst route; combined final damage was not simulated.","Uptime: every buff and debuff window is 2 rounds on a cooldown-7 cast, so Shell's 45% and Severance's 40% are live at most two rounds in seven.","Shadow Step's move row is unsupported and flagged enemy-hazard (positive ground row, friendly fire none); no node changes it. No supported row is adverse, ally-hazard or enemy-hazard.","Loom of Dusk is in 11 of 12 legal full allocations; only the Fortress build with Umbral Whetstone skips it.","Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. inside Shadow Shell"},"director_review":"none","concerns":["Burst against the old +5 Damage route: at the peak (all three buff windows live) about \u00d71.17 against \u00d71.18, and over one assumed rotation (Shell with Domain, then Step, Severance, Dance) about +12.5% against +15.6% (not simulated). The first pass's +6% version reached \u00d71.20 at the peak, above the old route, because compounding Increase Damage Given outgrew the 3 EP it replaced; holding the buffs at +5% makes the re-cut a small nerf at both the peak and the rotation while removing the four tier jumps. +3 Damage on Night Unraveled (40 \u2192 43) is not proposed: four Normal rows keep the roster's +2 default.","Barbed Thread (+3%) and Umbral Whetstone (+2%) are the same mechanic once names are hidden: Increase Damage Given on Domain, Step and Shell. Barbed Thread's value is the Burst capstone behind it; Umbral Whetstone's only non-dominated build is the Loom-free Fortress (06, 07, 08, 09). The kit has no fifth tag to give the leaf a distinct job; the alternative is dropping it, which makes Loom of Dusk universal.","Loom of Dusk is now +2% Decrease Damage Given only, so a Burst build pays its first point for a 32% sever (Shakunetsu Sakura's Falling Ember Petals also opens its burst route with a +2% Decrease Damage Given Foundation). Moving the Foundation's +2% Increase Damage Given off is what lets Barbed Thread carry a +3% setup while no allocation passes +5% on the three compounding buffs.","Suppression and Fortress each rest on one element-less row that the current resolver cannot reach (G1), and Shell's Increase Damage Given window (one of Burst's three) also needs G1 plus Shell's authored classification."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Shadow jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Night Unraveled path + Cloak of Woven Night
Strings Cut Short path + Cloak of Woven Night
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHADOW WEAVER KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
12 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Shadow classification / forked tree
